question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 F 组：日本 vs 瑞典（90 分钟赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group F: Japan vs Sweden (90-minute result)?
one_liner_cn: Elo 差近 200 分加不败势头使日本明显占优，但三笘/南野缺阵与瑞典 Gyökeres+Isak 锋线让爆冷概率不可忽视。
one_liner_en: A near-200-point Elo gap and an unbeaten run make Japan clear favourites, but Mitoma/Minamino absences and Sweden's Gyokeres-Isak front line keep the upset live.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 194 分（日本 1906 vs 瑞典 1712），中立场 Davidson 模型给日本约 58% 基线胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 194-point Elo gap (Japan 1906 vs Sweden 1712) yields a ~58% baseline Japan win probability in the neutral-venue Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 日本核心攻击手三笘薫（腘绳肌）与南野拓実（ACL）双双缺席世界杯名单，削弱破密集防守能力。
key_reasons.en: Japan is missing key attackers Kaoru Mitoma (hamstring) and Takumi Minamino (ACL) from its World Cup squad, weakening its ability to break down low blocks.

key_reasons.cn: 瑞典锋线 Gyökeres（阿森纳英超夺冠队内最佳射手）+ Isak 的天赋高于其 Elo 第 43 位排名所示。
key_reasons.en: Sweden's front line of Gyokeres (Arsenal's top scorer in a title-winning season) and Isak carries more talent than its 43rd Elo rank implies.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue) p_stat 0.579/0.232/0.190, bounded evidence adjustment (-3pp Japan, +1pp draw, +2pp Sweden, within ±8pp cap), renormalized. No betting/prediction-market data consulted.
